economy.summary: Her campaign platform calls for raising Pennsylvania's $7.25 minimum wage, creating policies to lower grocery prices, expanding affordable housing and support for first-time homebuyers, and protecting long-time residents from being priced out.
economy.short: Supports raising minimum wage, affordable housing, lowering grocery prices.

taxes.summary: Her campaign platform proposes lowering the Pennsylvania state sales tax, passing a severance tax on oil companies to increase state revenue, and legalizing marijuana to create taxable revenue.
taxes.short: Proposes lowering sales tax, severance tax, legalizing marijuana for revenue.

healthcare.summary: Her campaign platform proposes bringing primary care facilities and a hospital to the district, expanding rural healthcare investments, increasing access to mental health services, and reforming liability insurance to encourage physicians to practice in Pennsylvania.
healthcare.short: Proposes bringing a hospital, expanding rural healthcare and mental health.

energy.summary: Her campaign platform supports protecting waterways, forests, and public lands, enforcing strict ordinances regulating data centers, and pursuing environmental policies that also generate revenue.
energy.short: Supports protecting waterways and public lands, regulating data centers.

economy.summary: His website lists advancing pro-growth policies to help Pennsylvanians prosper among his priorities.
economy.short: Lists advancing pro-growth policies among his priorities.

taxes.summary: His website lists reducing taxes for hard-working families and seniors on fixed incomes among his priorities.
taxes.short: Lists reducing taxes for working families and seniors.

abortion.summary: His website lists defending the rights of the unborn among his priorities.
abortion.short: Lists defending the rights of the unborn.

education.summary: His website says he is working with school districts to fully empower and educate tomorrow's workforce.
education.short: Says he works with school districts on workforce education.

guns.summary: His website lists protecting the Second Amendment, reducing crime, and ensuring first responders have the resources they need to keep communities safe among his priorities, and notes he has hosted concealed carry seminars.
guns.short: Lists protecting Second Amendment, reducing crime, backing first responders.
